slides.title: Welcome to ShadowFlow
slides.speaker_notes: ShadowFlow is an autonomous AI workflow platform built for teams who need fast execution without vendor per-step fees.

slides.title: The Operational Bottleneck
slides.speaker_notes: Traditional automation tools force engineering teams to choose between brittle linear scripts or prohibitive per-task pricing tiers that penalize high volume.

slides.title: Deterministic Visual DAG Engine
slides.speaker_notes: Our visual canvas pairs sub-millisecond node execution with Anthropic's Model Context Protocol, enabling local models and cloud APIs to collaborate in a single graph.

slides.title: Production Benchmarks & Privacy
slides.speaker_notes: In production tests, self-hosted deployments reduce recurring inference expenditures by sixty-five percent while keeping sensitive payloads entirely within your private perimeter.

slides.title: Deploy Today on ShadowFlow
slides.speaker_notes: Inspect the open-source code on GitHub or launch your first sandbox workflow today at shadowflow dot work.
